items.title: AI industry is just following Jensen Huang's lead, Salesforce CEO explains

items.title: Lucid stock jumps on 25,000 robotaxi deal with Europe's Bolt
items.summary: Lucid (LCID) stock jumped on Wednesday after the electric vehicle maker signed a major partnership with European ride-hailing platform Bolt to deploy at least 25,000 autonomous vehicles across major European cities, extending Lucid's robotaxi push beyond the US for the first time.

items.title: Why Are Lucid (LCID) Shares Soaring Today
